name: scaffold-items-app
description: Hard: scaffold an authed Items app + matching rules + a run_workspace_tests probe. Multi-tool: write_file, run_workspace_tests. Tests whether the agent stages writes coherently before running.
prompt: Build a working Items list. Author rules so only signed-in users can read /items/{id} (no writes from clients). Author an App TSX that uses getFirestore(sandbox.withAuth({ uid: 'alice' })) to live-render every item document with onSnapshot. Then run the workspace tests (run_workspace_tests) to confirm everything deploys with no parse errors.
